Communicate status clearly — from inline alerts and live job trackers to the built-in real-time Notification Center in the top header bar.

Python builder YAML type What it renders aiui.alert(message, *, variant="info", title) alert Inline banner (info, success, warning, error) aiui.callout(content, *, variant="info", title) callout Highlighted note or tip block aiui.status(label, *, state, detail, progress, log) status Live job row (queued, running, done, failed) with progress bar & log tail aiui.toast(message, *, variant="info", duration=3000) toast Page-rendered toast banner aiui.spinner(text="Loading...") spinner Animated loading indicator aiui.skeleton(*, width, height, variant="text") skeleton Placeholder shimmer (text, card, avatar) aiui.empty(text="No data") empty Clean empty-state panel aiui.dialog(title, *, children, description, trigger_label, variant) dialog Modal dialog opened by a button aiui.popover(trigger, *, children) popover Contextual floating panel aiui.tooltip(child, *, content) tooltip Hover hint wrapping any child block

Every app shell ships with a modular, DRY Notification Center (builtin.notifications) in the top header bar: unread badge, All / Unread / Category filters, mark read, dismiss, and safe SPA action links — streamed live over SSE (/api/notifications/stream). See Notification Center architecture & REST/SSE API for custom storage (aiui.set_notification_store) and custom transport sources (notifications.registerSource).
